slides.texte_overlay:
signs you're an overthinker
(and what actually helps)

you replay conversations

you go over what you said hours later, looking for mistakes. what helps: write the thought down once, then close the notebook and let tomorrow handle it.

you need every detail first

you can't start anything until you've planned every step. what helps: pick the smallest first step and do it now, before your brain finds another question.

your mind never rests

your thoughts keep looping because they have nothing better to chew on. what helps: give your mind something calm and genuinely interesting every single day.
slides.texte_sophia:
your mind never rests

my mind used to loop all night. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and giving it something new to think about quiets the noise.

slides.texte_overlay:
you read into short replies

a one word message ruins your afternoon. what helps: remember most people are just busy, and their short replies are almost never about you or anything you did.

decisions exhaust you

even choosing lunch feels heavy. what helps: set small rules, like always picking the first good option, and save your energy for the choices that really matter to you.
